Agreement and eligibility

These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of CourtCheck, operated by Yin Hospitality International, LLC ("YHI," "we," "us," or "our"). By creating an account or using CourtCheck, you agree to these Terms and acknowledge the CourtCheck Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not create an account or use CourtCheck.

You must be at least 18 years old, legally able to agree to these Terms, and truthful when confirming your age during onboarding.

Accounts and SMS verification

CourtCheck requires a verified mobile phone number for account access. When you consent to receive a verification code and request one, CourtCheck sends an authentication SMS. These messages are transactional. Frequency depends on your requests, and standard message and data rates may apply. Carrier, network, filtering, or device conditions can affect delivery. Optional contact email is not a sign-in method.

Keep your phone number, device, session, and verification codes secure. Do not share codes or let someone else use your account. Provide accurate information and contact support if you suspect unauthorized use. CourtCheck assigns a username that cannot be edited in the app.

Facilities, occupancy, and availability

CourtCheck lets you find pickleball facilities, view activity, check in and out, and share facility conditions. Facility details such as hours, map locations, and amenities may be inaccurate, incomplete, or out of date. Activity counts show active CourtCheck check-ins. They do not count everyone at a facility or establish whether a court is available. Updates and reports can be delayed, and play-time rankings reflect recorded check-ins rather than independently verified playing time.

CourtCheck does not provide reservations, guaranteed court access, emergency services, or professional safety advice. Unless YHI separately says otherwise, YHI does not operate listed facilities. Verify conditions and availability with the facility as needed, follow posted rules, and use appropriate care.

Check-ins and automated expiration

To check in, allow foreground location access and be within the facility's server-defined check-in area. The server verifies that your location is inside the area. You may have one active check-in at a time. You may check out manually. Check-ins expire automatically after 90 minutes unless ended earlier, such as through facility deactivation. CourtCheck does not track when you leave the facility in the background. Check out when you leave.

Do not falsify your location or presence, check in for another person, or interfere with location verification. Do not rely on the app for emergencies, capacity control, or safety decisions.

Facility reports and submissions

Players with an active check-in can submit preset statuses for that facility, such as Open Courts, Need Players, or Maintenance. These reports expire under server-controlled rules. Players can also submit facility corrections and park suggestions to authorized administrators.

Submit information in good faith. You are responsible for what you submit. Do not send misleading, abusive, unlawful, or unnecessary personal information. You grant YHI a nonexclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to host, process, display, aggregate, and otherwise use submissions only as reasonably necessary to operate, secure, maintain, and improve CourtCheck and enforce these Terms. YHI may remove, end, limit, or correct submissions as reasonably necessary for accuracy, safety, legal obligations, or service integrity.

Acceptable use and administrator access

Use CourtCheck lawfully and respect other users and facilities. Do not harass, impersonate, deceive, or harm other people. Do not submit false activity or reports, access someone else's account or unauthorized areas, bypass security controls, distribute malicious code, scrape abusively, or disrupt CourtCheck.

Administrator tools are limited to authorized accounts. Administrators may manage facility information, public map locations, check-in areas, facility availability, and feedback. They may use their access only for authorized CourtCheck work.

Maps and other services

Maps and directions may depend on third-party services such as Apple Maps and Google Maps. CourtCheck sends the public facility destination when you request directions. The external service handles its own routes, starting location, permissions, and data. Third-party services may be governed by separate terms and may be unavailable or inaccurate.
